Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 17

“The great archer, the king of Kashi, the mighty warrior Shikhandi, Dhrishtadyumna, Virata, and the unconquered Satyaki.”

More key figures on the Pandava side sound their conches — including Shikhandi and Dhrishtadyumna, both of whom will play pivotal roles later in the war's most fateful moments.
